hero.subtitle: Check suspicious messages, links, images, and QR codes with friendly guidance every step of the way.

checker.heading: What feels off?
checker.linkHint: We won't open the link. We'll check its address and available safety signals.
checker.supportedTypes: PNG, JPG, JPEG • up to 10 MB
checker.fileErrorType: Please choose a PNG, JPG, or JPEG image.
checker.fileErrorSize: That image is too large. Choose a file under 10 MB.

result.heading: Your Result
result.idleCopy: Add something to check. We'll take a closer look.

notAi.title: Not AI
explanation: We didn't find strong signs that this was made by AI.
This doesn't guarantee that the content or sender is safe.
steps: Check that you recognize the sender.
Use a trusted source before taking action.

aiGenerated.title: AI-generated
explanation: Some details may have been created or changed with AI.
Treat the content carefully and verify its source independently.
steps: Don't share it as fact yet.
Verify the claim using a trusted source.
Avoid sending money or personal information.

unclear.title: Origin unclear
explanation: We couldn't gather enough evidence to tell where this came from.
Unclear doesn't mean safe—take a moment to verify it.
steps: Ask the sender through another channel.
Look for the same information on an official site.

how.heading: How it works
how.stepOneCopy: Paste a message or add an image, QR code, or link.
how.stepTwoCopy: Surfare checks helpful signals and explains what they mean.
how.stepThreeCopy: Get calm, practical suggestions before you act.
how.privacyCopy: Your content stays on this device for basic checks. If online verification is enabled, limited details may be sent to external threat-checking services. Never share passwords or private codes.

chat.heading: Ask Surfy
chat.intro: I can help you think through what to do next.
chat.learnQuestion: How can I spot this next time?
chat.whyAnswer: A warning sign is a reason to pause, not proof by itself. Check who sent it and verify important claims another way.
chat.nextAnswer: Don't click, pay, or share personal details yet. Contact the person or organization using a trusted channel.
chat.learnAnswer: Watch for urgency, unexpected requests, odd web addresses, and details that don't match. When in doubt, verify independently.

feedback.heading: Help us make Surfare better
feedback.copy: Your feedback helps us make safety tools more useful and welcoming.
feedback.commentPlaceholder: What worked well, or what could be better?

footer.copy: A little pause can make a big difference.
